prompt: Who was the second non-Asian men's soccer player to pass 100 international goals, and has long since passed the previous record international goalscorer, Iran's Ali Daei (109)?
answer: Lionel Messi. He became the second non-Asian men’s player to reach 100 international goals, after Cristiano Ronaldo, scoring his 100th for Argentina against Curaçao on March 28, 2023. Messi has since surpassed Ali Daei’s former mark of 109 goals.
